body:
An accepted English repair changed source bytes without changing canonical person contracts or primary identity evidence. Compare only the affected chapters through native normalization so their immutable dossier index can be reused. Changed people, claims, hints, mentions, Chinese text, construction code or configuration still block reuse; original index generations and independent chapter approvals remain unchanged.

Independent code recheck approved final head 03a2c99e2683fb1b6e21d83e395b4611106eb244 with no findings. Validation: ten pinned-source regressions, three parser regressions and three native publication fixtures pass, including changed-evidence/dirty-glossary rejection and index reuse with a correctly stale date approval. The sparse local runtime verified its static dependencies against deployed master without creating public/. This change grants no chapter approval and generates no pair assignments.

The real chapter preparation exposed an existing parser stall while reading stdin to EOF. Read an exact sealed byte count instead and bound the subprocess to ten seconds; parsing still uses Node’s native parser without linking or executing source. A regression deliberately leaves stdin open and verifies UTF-8 handling, no evaluation and explicit truncated-input failure.
